tool: iterate-until-verified skill (MengTo/Skills, agent-skills/codex/iterate-until-verified/SKILL.md), chosen over context-engineering because it prescribes an execute-verify loop for a task; context-engineering is about rules files and session setup

versions.agent: Claude Code subagents, same session model in both arms

fixtures: fixtures/16-multistep: a 6-file Node pet-food portion service (api, calculator, needs, catalogue, units, format) + data (14-product catalogue, factors with stage aliases) + logs/app.log (80 lines, 4 complainant lines, one red herring) + docs/PORTION-SPEC.md + a vague support ticket as README; hidden/run-tests.mjs (60 tests), grade.mjs, reference/, KEY.md with the v1→v3 hardening history
design: Plain-agent pilot, then hardening, three rounds: v1 (3 causes, explicit README, 23 tests) pilot 23/23; v2 (5 causes, vague README, 39 tests) pilot 39/39; v3 (7 interacting causes incl. a data row, a per-can unit, a stage-alias map, a rounding contract, spec-only rules for caps/meals/cans in docs/, one red-herring complainant whose 'fix' fails hidden tests, 60 tests; untouched 8/60) pilot 60/60. Stopped hardening after v3 as decided in advance. A/B on v3: 3 reps per arm, fresh copies; Arm B = same prompt + SKILL.md inline (Execute mode, verifier role performed by the same agent since no subagents). All six arm runs were interrupted once by an API rate limit and resumed; their usage covers the resumed segment, so the cost comparison is indicative only.

candidate_default.observed: Arm B wrote acceptance matrices, replayed every log line as a gate (one run recomputed all 69 successful requests with an independent script), and reported assumptions explicitly; Arm A found the same seven causes from the spec and the log without that scaffolding.

pilots: runs/16-multistep/pilots.jsonl (v1 23/23 in 78 s, v2 39/39 in 84 s, v3 60/60 in 135 s)
limits: Ceiling after three hardening rounds: the plain agent reads docs/, the log and the data and fixes all seven interacting causes; the task cannot separate the arms on quality.
Usage numbers for the six arm runs are post-resume segments (the rate limit cut each run once); direction (B costlier) is consistent with trials 10 (round 1) and 14, magnitude is approximate.
No interactive user and no subagents: the skill's fan-out and independent-verifier steps collapse into one agent, which is also how NEXUS would use it inside a subagent.
verdict: REJECT for bug-fixing tasks of this size (no quality gain at +20 % tokens, +50 % tool calls, roughly 3x wall time); WATCH only for tasks with a real external verifier
reason: Both arms scored 60/60 in all reps on a task hardened three times (plain pilot 23/23, 39/39, 60/60). The skill adds structure (gates, replay of the whole log) that costs time without changing the outcome here.
do_not_adopt_notes: Do not adopt as a default debugging wrapper; the measured effect is cost only.
